# A CLEAN impl MANIFEST. Fixture for test/shell/t_assert_stage.sh.
#
# ci/assert-stage.sh judges a finished stage BY READING THIS FILE - never by
# re-scraping the tool's own reports, because a second fuzzier opinion competing
# with the authoritative one is how a case-sensitive grep undercounted DRC by 7%
# for weeks in the reference project and nothing disagreed with it.
#
# So this file is the interface under test, and it is written out in full rather
# than generated: a reader has to be able to see which field each gate reads.
# The shape is CONTRACT.md section 5 - header, provenance, directories, both git
# shas, step_files, hooks_run, then the measurements.
#
# `dcp_bytes 4096` is load-bearing. The suite writes a 4096-byte checkpoint
# beside it and ci/assert-stage.sh cross-checks the two, because a manifest and
# a checkpoint that disagree are not from the same run.
#
